record.paper_title: Traces on Operator Ideals Defined over the Class of all Banach Spaces and Related Open Problems
record.original_question: For 1 <= r < \infty, compare the two operator ideals (P_{r,2})^{APP}_{r,\infty} and (L^{WEYL}_{r,\infty})^{APP}_{r,\infty}, where P_{r,2} is the ideal of (r,2)-summing operators and L^{WEYL}_{r,\infty} is the Weyl-number generated ideal. Show that these two ideals coincide.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $1 \le r < \infty$. Work in the category of bounded linear operators between Banach spaces. Recall the following definitions.

(a) The ideal $P_{r,2}$ of $(r,2)$-summing operators consists of all operators $T : X \to Y$ such that there is a constant $C \ge 0$ with
$$\Big(\sum_{k=1}^n \|T x_k\|^r\Big)^{1/r} \le C \sup\Big\{\Big(\sum_{k=1}^n |\langle x_k, x^*\rangle|^2\Big)^{1/2} : x^* \in X^*,\ \|x^*\| \le 1\Big\}$$
for every finite family $x_1,\dots,x_n \in X$.

(b) For an operator $T : X \to Y$ and $n \ge 1$, the $n$-th Weyl number $x_n(T)$ is defined by
$$x_n(T) = \sup\{ a_n(T A) : A : \ell_2 \to X,\ \|A\| \le 1\},$$
where $a_n(\cdot)$ denotes the $n$-th approximation number. The Weyl-number generated Lorentz-type ideal $L^{\mathrm{WEYL}}_{r,\infty}$ consists of those operators $T$ for which
$$\sup_{n \ge 1} n^{1/r} x_n(T) < \infty.$$

(c) The $n$-th approximation number of $T : X \to Y$ is
$$a_n(T) = \inf\{ \|T - F\| : F : X \to Y,\ \mathrm{rank}(F) < n\}.$$
Given a quasi-Banach operator ideal $\mathcal A$, define its approximation-Lorentz hull $\mathcal A^{\mathrm{APP}}_{r,\infty}$ as the class of all operators $T$ such that there exists a sequence $(T_k)$ with $T_k \in \mathcal A$ for which $\sup_{k \ge 1} k^{1/r} a_k(T - T_{k-1}) < \infty$ in an appropriate sense (the standard $(r,\infty)$-Lorentz approximation procedure applied to $\mathcal A$).

Prove that the two operator ideals
$$(P_{r,2})^{\mathrm{APP}}_{r,\infty} \quad \text{and} \quad (L^{\mathrm{WEYL}}_{r,\infty})^{\mathrm{APP}}_{r,\infty}$$
coincide.
